def corner_blocks(grid, fill=None):
    """Split the grid by rows/columns carrying rare marker colors; each lattice block gets color c if all 4 corner markers are c, else the fill color."""
    cnt = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    if fill is None:
        fill = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    keep = set(c for c, _ in cnt.most_common()[2:])
    mr = sorted({i for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v in keep})
    mc = sorted({j for row in grid for j, v in enumerate(row) if v in keep})
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(mr, mr[1:]):
        row = []
        for x, y in zip(mc, mc[1:]):
            cs = {grid[a][x], grid[a][y], grid[b][x], grid[b][y]}
            row.append(cs.pop() if len(cs) == 1 and cs <= keep else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
